dosignaliduna.name: Signal Iduna Park
dosignaliduna.slogan: A wall of yellow, 24,000 voices strong.
dosignaliduna.line: The Yellow Wall, the Südtribüne, is Europe's largest standing terrace, holding 24,454 fans.

dobergbaumuseum.name: German Mining Museum
dobergbaumuseum.slogan: Take the cage down into a real Ruhr mine.
dobergbaumuseum.line: Founded in 1930, the museum draws about 365,000 visitors a year to its reconstructed show mine.

dozollern.name: Zeche Zollern
dozollern.slogan: A coal mine dressed up as a palace.
dozollern.line: Its Art Nouveau entrance was designed by Berlin architect Bruno Möhring; the machine hall was finished in 1904.

doschiffshebewerkold.name: Henrichenburg Boat Lift
doschiffshebewerkold.slogan: Where ships once climbed 14 metres in a steel cradle.
doschiffshebewerkold.line: Kaiser Wilhelm II inaugurated the lift on 11 August 1899; it raised barges 14 metres.

dostarlightexpress.name: Starlight Express Theatre
dostarlightexpress.line: Built just for the show, the Bochum theatre has hosted Starlight Express since its premiere on 12 June 1988.
